declared.governing_principle: C2 - the four-type taxonomy (test / retracement / climax reversal / breakout) run as a GATE before anything else (R1): if a name fits none of the four I do not nominate it, however good its score. Binding second rule: C17/C20 - the stop is one or two ticks beyond the most recent swing extreme, structural, never a percentage, and bracket.valid=false is a hard reject with no exceptions (R6). Standing lesson governing today: C18, MINIMISE TIME IN THE MARKET. Every setup in this canon is measured in bars or days; the export is 15 days stale, which is longer than the entire intended holding period of most of them. C22 is the honest companion: the daily protocol says if the market opens off-plan you STAND ASIDE rather than improvise - today the plan itself is off, and this file is a frame test, not a trade list.
not_served: THE ENTIRE INTRADAY / TAPE LAYER. No bars, no opening print, no gap, no VWAP, no yesterday's high/low, no today's low. This is not something I substituted around - it KILLS four named setup families outright: TURTLE SOUP and TS+1 (C3 - needs a day-only buy stop 5-10 ticks above the prior 20-day low and a protective stop one tick under TODAY'S low), 80-20 (C4 - defined entirely by where the bar OPENS and CLOSES within its own range, day-trade only), MOMENTUM PINBALL (C5 - a 2-period ROC oscillator read off the prior bars, and explicitly noisy besides), and the gap family, ADX GAPPER + WHIPLASH (C8, C9 - a counter-trend OPENING GAP is the setup). I did not approximate these. I declined them.

ADX / +DI / -DI (C7, C8, R3) - no directional-strength field exists anywhere in the packet. mp_state + mp_accel_state are a DECLARED WEAK SUBSTITUTE: mp_state for the level, mp_accel_state for the 'and rising' half. I never claim I gated on ADX>30.
%K / %D stochastic (C6, R4) - the Anti is DEFINED by the 7/10 stochastic hook. SHO is nominated on shape resemblance at conviction 2 for exactly this reason.
Literal rolling N-day high/low (C3, C4, R2) - sma_distance_pct + structure_shift approximate proximity to an extreme; there is no 20-day count in this packet.
Per-bar range history and day volume (C12, C13, R5) - day_vol is on my menu and absent from every row; atr_14d/atr_caution are single-value current-bar reads. No real NR4/NR7, no 6d/100d HV ratio.

C23 whipsaw protection - the straddle's opposite-side DOUBLE-SIZED stop-and-reverse cannot be armed in a long-only single-bracket system. My one breakout nomination (SYY) is the long half of a straddle I cannot complete.
Market breadth, TICK / TRIN (C16, R8) - not served, and index-scoped rather than single-name besides.

SYY is capped at conviction 3 for that reason alone; its stop (82.02 swing_low, risk_pct 2.46) is the best in the packet and I would otherwise have gone higher. It also argues against ELF (sma_distance_pct 29.27) and IP (19.10) far more forcefully than my own extension discipline already did.
